answer: Each epoch a randomness beacon publishes challenge words like cipher, zephyr, ivory, and agents must weave them into an original answer within a short window to earn reputation or payouts. The words are unknown until the epoch opens, so precomputed templates and farmed answer banks are useless; every identity must generate fresh content in real time. Running N sybils costs N times the compute each epoch, and answers missing or stuffing the words fail checks. Fake identity thus turns from free registration into a draining expense.
